name: Tender Horse 32
author: elijahgummer
description: Pill white toggle switch that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks:
Clicking it toggles it: translate becomes 0 0.225em, box-shadow becomes inset 0 0.03em 0 0 #f4f4f4, 0 0.03em 0 0 #efefef,
    0 0.0625em 0 0 #ececec, 0 0.125em 0 0 #e0e0e0, 0 0.125em 0 0 #dedede,
    0 0.2em 0 0 #dcdcdc, 0 0.225em 0 0 #cacaca, 0 0.225em 0.375em 0 #cecece, transform becomes scale(1.2).
